mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.2pp), or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates supply-demand mismatch where strong consumer demand offsets supply shocks, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls > 0.5% and HOUST rises > 0.5% in the same month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a relative increase in retail sales (RSAFS) versus GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS/GDPC1 ratio increases by at least 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) increase exceeding 100,000 signals labor market strength, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in UNRATE signals recessionary policy response, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days during economic downturns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS falls > 0.25pp and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shocks (INDPRO decline > 1.0% monthly), reduced industrial output lowers corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls > 1.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
